label: ThinkSystem SR250 1U rack server
description: 1U single-socket entry rack server with two embedded 1GbE ports (Broadcom 5720) and a 1GbE port dedicated to the XClarity Controller. Expansion is two PCIe Gen4 slots - a 10GbE NIC would be a stand-up card.
notes: Onboard: 2x 1GbE (BCM5720) plus 1x 1GbE dedicated XCC management port. No OCP bay on this model; 2x PCIe Gen4 slots (x8/x8 or x16) take any 10GbE adapter. XCC port is a separate management network.
